title: How Many Statement Cycles a Standing Automatic Payment Is Spread Over, by Savings Relationship
content:
On a card under Personal Credit Cards, the number of statement cycles over which a fixed monthly sum is spread is read from the cardholder's holdings under Savings & Money Market Accounts.

1. Where the cardholder holds an active savings account whose balance is at least 25000.00 USD and at least 1 savings deposit posted to the cardholder's savings accounts in the last three months, the amount is spread over 6 statement cycles.

2. Where the cardholder holds an active savings account whose balance is below 25000.00 USD and at least 1 savings deposit posted to the cardholder's savings accounts in the last three months, the amount is spread over 3 statement cycles.

3. Where neither of those holds, the amount is spread over a single statement cycle.

**Both parts of each tier.** An active savings account of the stated balance and at least 1 savings deposit in the last three months are required together. A cardholder whose active savings balance is 80000.00 USD but whose savings accounts show no deposit in the last three months falls in the third tier.

**What the spread is worth.** On a hypothetical figure of 899.685 USD before the spread, the first tier gives 149.9475 USD a cycle, the second gives 299.895 USD and the third leaves 899.685 USD. A balance of exactly 25000.00 USD belongs to the first tier, the test being at least that amount.
